## PLOT GENERA

```{r}
phy <- tdat_disc$phy

#pdf(
# "C:/Users/maela/OneDrive/Documents/Files/3M Course/Assignment Stuff/GeneraPhylogeny.pdf",
 #width = 10,
 # height = 12
#)

#par(mar = c(6, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1)

# define genera (from each focal group)
focal_clades <- list(
  "Anomalopus" = c(
    "Anomalopus", "Calyptotis", "Coeranoscincus",
    "Coggeria", "Ophioscincus", "Concinnia",
    "Nangura", "Silvascincus"
  ),
  "Glaphyromorphus" = c("Glaphyromorphus", "Eulamprus"),
  "Hemiergis" = c("Hemiergis", "Eremiascincus"),
  "Lerista" = c("Lerista", "Ctenotus")
)

# extract genus (that is the name for each genus)
genus <- sub("_.*", "", phy$tip.label)

# getting the node for each focal group
nodes <- sapply(focal_clades, function(genera) {
  tips <- phy$tip.label[genus %in% genera]
  if (length(tips) > 1) getMRCA(phy, tips) else NA
})

box_cols <- c(
  "Anomalopus" = "violet",
  "Glaphyromorphus" = "blue",
  "Hemiergis" = "skyblue",
  "Lerista" = "maroon"
)

# plot tree
plot(
  phy, show.tip.label = TRUE,
  main = "Sphenomorphinae Phylogeny",
  cex = 0.5
)

par(xpd = NA)

legend(
  "bottom",
  inset = c(0, 0.-0.05),
  legend = names(box_cols),
  pch = 21,
  pt.bg = box_cols,
  horiz = TRUE,
  bty = "n",
  cex = 0.9
)


# opaque outline
for (group in names(nodes)) {
  if (!is.na(nodes[group])) {
    box <- cladebox(
      node = nodes[group],
      col = adjustcolor(box_cols[group], alpha.f = 0.15)
    )
    
    polygon(
      box$x, box$y,
      col = NA,
      border = box_cols[group],
      lwd = 1.5
    )
  }
}

#dev.off()
```
## POLYMORPHOSPACE

```{r}
graphics.off()

#pdf(
 #"C:/Users/maela/OneDrive/Documents/Files/3M Course/Assignment Stuff/Polymorphospace.pdf",
# width = 10,
 # height = 12
#)

tree <- tdat_disc$phy

focal_genera <- list(
  "Anomalopus" = c(
    "Anomalopus", "Calyptotis", "Coeranoscincus",
    "Coggeria", "Ophioscincus", "Concinnia",
    "Nangura", "Silvascincus"
  ),
  "Glaphyromorphus" = c("Glaphyromorphus", "Eulamprus"),
  "Hemiergis" = c("Hemiergis", "Eremiascincus"),
  "Lerista" = c("Lerista", "Ctenotus")
)

box_cols <- c(
  "Anomalopus" = "violet",
  "Glaphyromorphus" = "blue",
  "Hemiergis" = "skyblue",
  "Lerista" = "maroon"
)

# Assign focal groups
genus <- sub("_.*$", "", df$species)
df$focal_group <- NA_character_

for (grp in names(focal_genera)) {
  df$focal_group[genus %in% focal_genera[[grp]]] <- grp
}

## RAW LIMB LENGTH

limb_traits <- c("fll", "hll", "tll")

limb_labels <- c(
  fll = "Front limb length",
  hll = "Hind limb length",
  tll = "Total limb length"
)


# Reset plotting device and layout
layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3,
                4, 4, 4),
              nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
       heights = c(4, 1))

par(mar = c(5, 4, 3, 1))


for (trait in limb_traits) {
  
  plot_df <- df[
    complete.cases(df[, c("species", "bd_wmean", "focal_group", trait)]) &
      df$species %in% tree$tip.label,
  ]
  
  X <- as.matrix(plot_df[, c("bd_wmean", trait)])
  rownames(X) <- plot_df$species
  colnames(X) <- c("Soil bulk density", limb_labels[trait])
  
  td <- geiger::treedata(
    phy = tree,
    data = X,
    sort = TRUE,
    warnings = TRUE
  )
  
  X_matched <- td$data[td$phy$tip.label, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # Match focal groups to the tree-tip order
  matched_rows <- match(td$phy$tip.label, plot_df$species)
  matched_groups <- plot_df$focal_group[matched_rows]
  point_cols <- unname(box_cols[matched_groups])
  
  # Draw branches and morphospace without visible tip symbols
  phytools::phylomorphospace(
    tree = td$phy,
    X = X_matched,
    label = "off",
    xlab = "Soil bulk density",
    ylab = limb_labels[trait],
    node.size = c(0, 0),
    pch = NA,
    col = "grey40",
    cex = 0
  )
  
  # Draw colored terminal nodes at the exact branch endpoints
  points(
    X_matched[, 1],
    X_matched[, 2],
    pch = 21,
    bg = point_cols,
    col = "black",
    cex = 1.1
  )
  
  title(main = paste("Soil density vs.", limb_labels[trait]))
}

#par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
par(mar = c(0,0,0,0))

plot.new()

legend(
  "center",
  legend = c("Focal Group", names(box_cols)),
  pch = c(NA, rep(21, length(box_cols))),
  pt.bg = c(NA, box_cols),
  col = c(NA, rep("black", length(box_cols))),
  horiz = TRUE,
  bty = "n",
  pt.cex = 2,
  x.intersp = 1.2,
  inset = c(-0.1, -0.15),
  cex = 1.4
)

#dev.off()
```

## DIVERSIFICATION MODELS

```{r}
require(diversitree)

tree_ultra <- chronos(tree)

is.ultrametric(tree_ultra)

tr <- tree_ultra

# Results matrix

modelfitres <- matrix(nrow = 6, ncol = 5)

colnames(modelfitres) <- c(
  "logL",
  "AIC",
  "Speciation",
  "Extinction",
  "RateChange"
)

rownames(modelfitres) <- c(
  "Yule Constant",
  "Yule Exponential",
  "Yule Linear",
  "BirthDeath Constant",
  "BirthDeath Exponential",
  "BirthDeath Linear"
)


startyule <- starting.point.bd(tr, yule = TRUE)
startbd <- starting.point.bd(tr, yule = FALSE)

# Yule Constant

lik_yule_const <- make.yule(tr)

startyule <- starting.point.bd(tr, yule = TRUE)

fit_yule_const <- find.mle(
  lik_yule_const,
  x.init = startyule[1]
)

summary(fit_yule_const)

modelfitres[1,1] <- logLik(fit_yule_const)
modelfitres[1,2] <- AIC(fit_yule_const)
modelfitres[1,3] <- coef(fit_yule_const)

# Yule Exponential

lik_exp <- make.bd.t(
  tr,
  functions = c(
    lambda = "exp.t",
    mu = "constant.t"
  ),
  sampling.f = 1
)

lik_yule_exp <- constrain(
  lik_exp,
  mu ~ 0
)

fit_yule_exp <- find.mle(
  lik_yule_exp,
  x.init = c(
    lambda.l = startbd[1],
    lambda.a = 0
  ))

modelfitres[2,1] <- logLik(fit_yule_exp)
modelfitres[2,2] <- AIC(fit_yule_exp)
modelfitres[2,3] <- coef(fit_yule_exp)[1]
modelfitres[2,5] <- coef(fit_yule_exp)[2]

# Yule Linear

lik_lin <- make.bd.t(
  tr,
  functions = c(
    lambda = "linear.t",
    mu = "constant.t"
  ),
  sampling.f = 1
)

lik_yule_lin <- constrain(
  lik_lin,
  mu ~ 0
)

fit_yule_lin <- find.mle(
  lik_yule_lin,
  x.init = c(
    lambda.c = startbd[1],
    lambda.m = 0
  ))

modelfitres[3,1] <- logLik(fit_yule_lin)
modelfitres[3,2] <- AIC(fit_yule_lin)
modelfitres[3,3] <- coef(fit_yule_lin)[1]
modelfitres[3,5] <- coef(fit_yule_lin)[2]

# Birth-Death Constant

lik_bd_const <- make.bd(
  tr,
  sampling.f = 1
)

fit_bd_const <- find.mle(
  lik_bd_const,
  x.init = startbd,
)

modelfitres[4,1] <- logLik(fit_bd_const)
modelfitres[4,2] <- AIC(fit_bd_const)
modelfitres[4,3] <- coef(fit_bd_const)[1]
modelfitres[4,4] <- coef(fit_bd_const)[2]

# Birth-Death Exponential

fit_bd_exp <- find.mle(
  lik_exp,
  x.init = c(
    lambda.l = startbd[1],
    lambda.a = 0,
    mu = startbd[2]
  ))

modelfitres[5,1] <- logLik(fit_bd_exp)
modelfitres[5,2] <- AIC(fit_bd_exp)
modelfitres[5,3] <- coef(fit_bd_exp)[1]
modelfitres[5,5] <- coef(fit_bd_exp)[2]
modelfitres[5,4] <- coef(fit_bd_exp)[3]

# Birth-Death Linear

fit_bd_lin <- find.mle(
  lik_lin,
  x.init = c(
    lambda.c = startbd[1],
    lambda.m = 0,
    mu = startbd[2]
  ))

modelfitres[6,1] <- logLik(fit_bd_lin)
modelfitres[6,2] <- AIC(fit_bd_lin)
modelfitres[6,3] <- coef(fit_bd_lin)[1]
modelfitres[6,5] <- coef(fit_bd_lin)[2]
modelfitres[6,4] <- coef(fit_bd_lin)[3]

# Calculate Delta AIC

deltaAIC <- modelfitres[,2] - min(modelfitres[,2])

results2 <- cbind(
  modelfitres,
  DeltaAIC = deltaAIC
)

results2

```

## REGRESSION PGLs (Maelan Code)
Head length as covariate

``` {r}

#pdf(
 #"C:/Users/maela/OneDrive/Documents/Files/3M Course/Assignment Stuff/RegressionPGL.pdf",
 #width = 10,
  #height = 12
#)

traits <- c("fll", "hll", "tll")

plots <- list()

model_results <- data.frame()

for(i in seq_along(traits)) {

  trait <- traits[i]

  # Create dataset for this trait
  plot_dat <- df[, c(
    "species",
    "focal_group",
    "bd_wmean",
    "hd_l",
    trait
  )]

  plot_dat <- na.omit(plot_dat)

  # Comparative data object
  comp_dat <- comparative.data(
    phy = tdat_disc$phy,
    data = plot_dat,
    names.col = "species",
    vcv = TRUE
  )


  # LINEAR MODEL

  mod_lin <- pgls(
    as.formula(
      paste(
        trait,
        "~ bd_wmean + hd_l"
      )
    ),
    data = comp_dat,
    lambda = "ML"
  )

  
  # QUADRATIC MODEL

  mod_quad <- pgls(
    as.formula(
      paste(
        trait,
        "~ bd_wmean + I(bd_wmean^2) + hd_l"
      )
    ),
    data = comp_dat,
    lambda = "ML"
  )


  # MODEL COMPARISON

  aic_lin <- AIC(mod_lin)
  aic_quad <- AIC(mod_quad)

  delta_aic <- aic_lin - aic_quad

  quad_coef <- summary(mod_quad)$coefficients

  model_results <- rbind(
    model_results,
    data.frame(
      Trait = trait,
      Linear_AIC = aic_lin,
      Quadratic_AIC = aic_quad,
      Delta_AIC = delta_aic,
      Quad_Beta =
        quad_coef["I(bd_wmean^2)", "Estimate"],
      Quad_P =
        quad_coef["I(bd_wmean^2)", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    )
  )


  # PREDICTIONS

  pred <- data.frame(
    bd_wmean = seq(
      min(plot_dat$bd_wmean),
      max(plot_dat$bd_wmean),
      length.out = 200
    ),
    hd_l = mean(
      plot_dat$hd_l,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

  pred$linear_fit <- predict(
    mod_lin,
    newdata = pred
  )

  pred$quad_fit <- predict(
    mod_quad,
    newdata = pred
  )

  
  # PLOT

  plots[[i]] <- ggplot(
    plot_dat,
    aes(
      x = bd_wmean,
      y = .data[[trait]],
      color = focal_group
    )
  ) +

    geom_point(size = 3) +

    geom_line(
      data = pred,
      aes(
        x = bd_wmean,
        y = linear_fit
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      colour = "gray",
      linewidth = 1,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +

    geom_line(
      data = pred,
      aes(
        x = bd_wmean,
        y = quad_fit
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 1
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Anomalopus" = "violet",
        "Glaphyromorphus" = "blue",
        "Hemiergis" = "skyblue",
        "Lerista" = "maroon"
      ),
      name = "Focal Group"
    ) +

    theme_classic() +

    labs(
      x = "Soil bulk density",
      y = c(
        fll = "Forelimb length",
        hll = "Hindlimb length",
        tll = "Total limb length"
      )[trait],
      subtitle = paste(
        "ΔAIC =",
        round(delta_aic, 2)
      )
    )
}

# Display AIC comparison table
print(model_results)

# Display all plots
(plots[[1]] | plots[[2]] | plots[[3]]) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14)
  )

#dev.off()
```

## REGRESSION PGL ANALYSIS (Maelan Code)
Head length as covariate

```{r}
traits <- c("fll", "hll", "tll")

results <- data.frame()

for(trait in traits){

  plot_dat <- df[, c("species", "focal_group", "bd_wmean", "hd_l", trait)]
  plot_dat <- na.omit(plot_dat)

  comp_dat <- comparative.data(
    phy = tdat_disc$phy,
    data = plot_dat,
    names.col = "species",
    vcv = TRUE
  )

 mod <- pgls(
  as.formula(
    paste(
      trait,
      "~ bd_wmean + hd_l"
    )
  ),
  data = comp_dat,
  lambda = "ML"
)

  coef_tab <- summary(mod)$coefficients

  beta <- coef_tab["bd_wmean", "Estimate"]
  se <- coef_tab["bd_wmean", "Std. Error"]
  p_value <- coef_tab["bd_wmean", "Pr(>|t|)"]

  observed <- comp_dat$data[[trait]]
  predicted <- fitted(mod)

  r2 <- cor(observed, predicted)^2

  df_res <- length(observed) - 2
  tcrit <- qt(0.975, df_res)

  lower95 <- beta - tcrit * se
  upper95 <- beta + tcrit * se

  results <- rbind(
    results,
    data.frame(
      Trait = trait,
      Beta = beta,
      P_value = p_value,
      R2 = r2,
      Lower95CI = lower95,
      Upper95CI = upper95
    )
  )

}

print(results)

```


## PGLs WITH FOCAL GROUP INTERACTIONS
Head length as covariate

```{r}
traits <- c("fll", "hll", "tll")

interaction_results <- data.frame()

for(trait in traits) {

  plot_dat <- df[, c(
    "species",
    "focal_group",
    "bd_wmean",
    "hd_l",
    trait
  )]

  plot_dat <- na.omit(plot_dat)

  comp_dat <- comparative.data(
    phy = tdat_disc$phy,
    data = plot_dat,
    names.col = "species",
    vcv = TRUE
  )

  # Main model
  mod_main <- pgls(
    as.formula(
      paste(
        trait,
        "~ bd_wmean + focal_group + hd_l"
      )
    ),
    data = comp_dat,
    lambda = "ML"
  )

  # Interaction model
  mod_interaction <- pgls(
    as.formula(
      paste(
        trait,
        "~ bd_wmean * focal_group + hd_l"
      )
    ),
    data = comp_dat,
    lambda = "ML"
  )

  interaction_results <- rbind(
    interaction_results,
    data.frame(
      Trait = trait,
      Main_AIC = AIC(mod_main),
      Interaction_AIC = AIC(mod_interaction),
      Delta_AIC =
        AIC(mod_main) -
        AIC(mod_interaction)
    )
  )

  cat("\n===========================\n")
  cat("Trait:", trait, "\n")
  cat("===========================\n")

  print(summary(mod_interaction))
}

interaction_results
```

## PGLs WITH FOCAL GROUP INTERACTIONS
Head length as covariate

```{r}

#pdf(
 #"C:/Users/maela/OneDrive/Documents/Files/3M Course/Assignment Stuff/FocalGroupInteractionPGL.pdf",
 #width = 10,
  #height = 12
#)
  
plots <- list()

for(i in seq_along(traits)) {

  trait <- traits[i]

  plot_dat <- df[, c(
    "species",
    "focal_group",
    "bd_wmean",
    "hd_l",
    trait
  )]

  plot_dat <- na.omit(plot_dat)

  plot_dat$focal_group <- factor(
    plot_dat$focal_group
  )

  plot_dat$focal_group <- droplevels(
    plot_dat$focal_group
  )

  if(length(levels(plot_dat$focal_group)) < 2){
    cat(
      "\nSkipping",
      trait,
      "- fewer than 2 focal groups remain\n"
    )
    next
  }

  comp_dat <- comparative.data(
    phy = tdat_disc$phy,
    data = plot_dat,
    names.col = "species",
    vcv = TRUE
  )

  mod_interaction <- pgls(
    as.formula(
      paste(
        trait,
        "~ bd_wmean * focal_group + hd_l"
      )
    ),
    data = comp_dat,
    lambda = "ML"
  )


  pred_list <- lapply(
    split(plot_dat, plot_dat$focal_group),
    function(x){

      newdat <- data.frame(
        bd_wmean = seq(
          min(x$bd_wmean),
          max(x$bd_wmean),
          length.out = 100
        ),
        focal_group = factor(
          rep(
            unique(x$focal_group),
            100
          ),
          levels = levels(plot_dat$focal_group)
        ),
        hd_l = mean(
          x$hd_l,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      )

      newdat$fit <- predict(
        mod_interaction,
        newdata = newdat
      )

      newdat
    }
  )

  pred <- do.call(
    rbind,
    pred_list
  )

  plots[[i]] <- ggplot(
    plot_dat,
    aes(
      x = bd_wmean,
      y = .data[[trait]],
      colour = focal_group
    )
  ) +

    geom_point(
      size = 3,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +

    geom_line(
      data = pred,
      aes(
        x = bd_wmean,
        y = fit,
        colour = focal_group
      ),
      linewidth = 1.2
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Anomalopus" = "violet",
        "Glaphyromorphus" = "blue",
        "Hemiergis" = "skyblue",
        "Lerista" = "maroon"
      ),
      name = "Focal Group"
    ) +

    theme_classic() +

    labs(
      title = paste(
        "Interaction Model -",
        trait
      ),
      x = "Soil bulk density",
      y = c(
        fll = "Forelimb length",
        hll = "Hindlimb length",
        tll = "Total limb length"
      )[trait]
    )
}

(plots[[1]] | plots[[2]] | plots[[3]]) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14)
  )

#dev.off()
```

```{r}
#pdf(

  #height = 12
#)

traits <- c("fll", "hll", "tll")
groups <- unique(na.omit(df$focal_group))

plots <- list()
counter <- 1

for(trait in traits){

  for(grp in groups){

    # Subset focal group
    plot_dat <- df[
      df$focal_group == grp,
      c("species", "focal_group", "bd_wmean", "hd_l", trait)
    ]

    plot_dat <- na.omit(plot_dat)

    if(nrow(plot_dat) < 5) next

    # Comparative data object
    comp_dat <- comparative.data(
      phy = tdat_disc$phy,
      data = plot_dat,
      names.col = "species",
      vcv = TRUE
    )

    # FIT PGLS MODEL
    mod <- pgls(
      as.formula(
        paste(trait, "~ bd_wmean + hd_l")
      ),
      data = comp_dat,
      lambda = "ML"
    )

    print(summary(mod))

    # Prediction line holding head length constant
    pred <- data.frame(
      bd_wmean = seq(
        min(plot_dat$bd_wmean),
        max(plot_dat$bd_wmean),
        length.out = 100
      ),
      hd_l = mean(
        plot_dat$hd_l,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )

    pred$fit <- predict(mod, newdata = pred)

    # Plot
    plots[[counter]] <- ggplot(
      plot_dat,
      aes(
        x = bd_wmean,
        y = .data[[trait]]
      )
    ) +

      geom_point(
        color = c(
          "Anomalopus" = "violet",
          "Glaphyromorphus" = "blue",
          "Hemiergis" = "skyblue",
          "Lerista" = "maroon"
        )[grp],
        size = 2
      ) +

      geom_line(
        data = pred,
        aes(x = bd_wmean, y = fit),
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 1
      ) +

      theme_classic() +

      labs(
        title = paste(grp, "-", trait),
        x = "Soil bulk density",
        y = c(
          fll = "Forelimb length",
          hll = "Hindlimb length",
          tll = "Total limb length"
        )[trait]
      )

    counter <- counter + 1
  }
}

wrap_plots(plots)

#dev.off()

```

## REGRESSION PGL ANALYSIS FOR INDIVIDUAL GROUPS (Maelan Code)
Head length as covariate 

```{r}

traits <- c("fll", "hll", "tll")
groups <- unique(df$focal_group)

results3 <- data.frame()

for(trait in traits) {

  for(grp in groups) {

    plot_dat <- df[df$focal_group == grp,
                   c("species", "focal_group", "bd_wmean","hd_l", trait)]

    plot_dat <- na.omit(plot_dat)

    if(nrow(plot_dat) < 5) next

    comp_dat <- comparative.data(
      phy = tdat_disc$phy,
      data = plot_dat,
      names.col = "species",
      vcv = TRUE
    )

  mod <- pgls(
  as.formula(
    paste(
      trait,
      "~ bd_wmean + hd_l"
    )
  ),
  data = comp_dat,
  lambda = "ML"
)

    coef_tab <- summary(mod)$coefficients

    beta <- coef_tab["bd_wmean", "Estimate"]
    pval <- coef_tab["bd_wmean", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    r2 <- summary(mod)$r.squared

    # Calculate 95% CI from standard error
    se <- coef_tab["bd_wmean", "Std. Error"]

    lower95 <- beta - 1.96 * se
    upper95 <- beta + 1.96 * se

    results3 <- rbind(
      results3,
      data.frame(
        Trait = trait,
        Group = grp,
        Beta = beta,
        P_value = pval,
        R2 = r2,
        Lower95CI = lower95,
        Upper95CI = upper95
      )
    )
  }
}

results3

```

## RELATIVE LIMB PCA (Maelan Code)

```{r}

pca_dat <- df %>%
  dplyr::select(
    species,
    focal_group,
    hd_l,
    fll,
    hll,
    tll
  ) %>%
  na.omit()

# Relative limb lengths

pca_dat$rel_fll <- pca_dat$fll / pca_dat$hd_l
pca_dat$rel_hll <- pca_dat$hll / pca_dat$hd_l
pca_dat$rel_tll <- pca_dat$tll / pca_dat$hd_l

# PCA

morph_pca <- prcomp(
  pca_dat[, c(
    "rel_fll",
    "rel_hll",
    "rel_tll"
  )],
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = TRUE
)

# PCA summary

summary(morph_pca)

# Trait loadings

morph_pca$rotation


## SAVE PC SCORES

scores <- data.frame(
  species = pca_dat$species,
  MorphPC1 = morph_pca$x[,1],
  MorphPC2 = morph_pca$x[,2]
)

# Remove old PCA columns if present

df <- df %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -any_of(c(
      "MorphPC1",
      "MorphPC2"
    ))
  )

# Join new PCA scores

df <- dplyr::left_join(
  df,
  scores,
  by = "species"
)

# Check

summary(df$MorphPC1)
summary(df$MorphPC2)

```

## FIT MODELS (Maelan Code)
Using relative limb length and PCA axis

```{r}
library(geiger)
library(ape)
library(dplyr)

# Relative limb traits

df$rel_fll <- df$fll / df$hd_l
df$rel_hll <- df$hll / df$hd_l
df$rel_tll <- df$tll / df$hd_l

traits <- c(
  "rel_fll",
  "rel_hll",
  "rel_tll",
  "MorphPC1"
)

phy <- tdat_disc$phy

model_results <- list()

for(trait in traits){

  cat("\n=========================\n")
  cat("Fitting models for:", trait, "\n")
  cat("=========================\n")


# Match species and tree

  trait_dat <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      species,
      all_of(trait)
    ) %>%
    na.omit()

  trait_vec <- trait_dat[[trait]]
  names(trait_vec) <- trait_dat$species

  td <- treedata(
    phy = phy,
    data = trait_vec,
    sort = TRUE
  )

  vec <- td$data[,1]
  names(vec) <- rownames(td$data)


# Fit models

  BM_fit <- fitContinuous(td$phy,vec,model = "BM")

  OU_fit <- fitContinuous(td$phy,vec,model = "OU")

  EB_fit <- fitContinuous(td$phy,vec,model = "EB")

  WN_fit <- fitContinuous(td$phy,vec,model = "white")

  Lambda_fit <- fitContinuous(td$phy,vec,model = "lambda")

  
  tmp <- data.frame(Trait = trait,Model = c("BM","OU","EB","White","Lambda"),

    logLik = c(
      BM_fit$opt$lnL,
      OU_fit$opt$lnL,
      EB_fit$opt$lnL,
      WN_fit$opt$lnL,
      Lambda_fit$opt$lnL
    ),

    AICc = c(
      BM_fit$opt$aicc,
      OU_fit$opt$aicc,
      EB_fit$opt$aicc,
      WN_fit$opt$aicc,
      Lambda_fit$opt$aicc
    ),

    Parameter = c(
      NA,
      OU_fit$opt$alpha,
      EB_fit$opt$a,
      NA,
      Lambda_fit$opt$lambda
    )
  )


  tmp <- tmp %>%
    mutate(
      Delta_AICc = AICc - min(AICc),
      RelLik = exp(
        -0.5 * Delta_AICc
      ),
      AkaikeWeight =
        RelLik / sum(RelLik)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Delta_AICc)

  best_model <- tmp$Model[1]

  tmp$BestModel <- best_model

  model_results[[trait]] <- tmp

  cat(
    "\nBest model:",
    best_model,
    "\n"
  )
}


all_models <- do.call(
  rbind,
  model_results
)

all_models

# BEST MODEL TABLE 

best_models <- all_models %>%
  group_by(Trait) %>%
  slice_min(
    AICc,
    n = 1
  ) %>%
  select(
    Trait,
    Model,
    Parameter,
    logLik,
    AICc,
    Delta_AICc,
    AkaikeWeight
  )

best_models

```
